sourceText: The proposal now drops the unsupported microphone-icon criterion, narrows scope to the adapter and its test file, and strengthens cancellation acceptance to require per-track stop/readyState checks across one- and three-track sessions plus negative controls. The remaining concern is that the verification is still proposed rather than executed, so it does not yet demonstrate the implementation passes.
